title: Q-BLIND-one-click-unsubscribe: close the outreach blind spot one-click-unsubscribe
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** every blindspots scan
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation blindspots --closed one-click-unsubscribe
**Prediction:** blindspots_open <= 5 within 168 h
**Status:** closed

Why the owner would not know to ask: Gmail, Yahoo and Microsoft expect a List-Unsubscribe header with one-click unsubscribe (RFC 8058) on automated mail; the intro lane has an opt-out line and domain suppression but sends no such header (found by the 2026-11-20 outreach sweep; the lane is in dry-run, so nothing has been sent without it).
Action: add List-Unsubscribe and List-Unsubscribe-Post headers to the intro message and an endpoint that records the opt-out, before mode leaves dry-run. The probe in doctrine/blindspots.json passes when it is done.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-25T17:32:50Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 121.9 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
